events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: This exhibition showcases 35 artworks by 25 leading contemporary Chinese artists, providing a powerful snapshot of 21st-century Chinese creativity and culture through large-scale installations, video, photography, painting, and sculpture. A public program of talks and workshops is available for deeper engagement.

events.title: LOVING — Queer Photography Exhibition
events.description: HOTA hosts *LOVING*, an international queer photographic exhibition as part of Gold Coast Pride Month. This compelling collection explores themes relevant to the queer community through the lens of photography.

events.title: UNLEASHED+ — Craft & Design Exhibition
events.description: Presented in collaboration with artisan, Queensland's premier craft and design organisation, UNLEASHED+ 2026 is a biennial exhibition showcasing exceptional work from makers and creators. It highlights the development and profiling of craft and design through place-based programs.

events.title: Bond Together — Mental Health Crash Course
events.description: Part of Bond University's wellbeing series, this crash course offers an introduction to mental health, fostering conversation and connection within the university and wider community. It's designed to provide foundational knowledge and encourage dialogue.

events.title: Executive Lunch & Learn: AI for Productivity Workflows
events.description: Bond University hosts an intellectually focused session exploring practical applications of AI to enhance productivity workflows. This 'lunch and learn' event is designed for professionals and those interested in cutting-edge technology.

events.title: Bond University Graduation Ceremonies
events.description: Celebrate with the graduating class of January 2026 semester at Bond University. These ceremonies are a significant community milestone, open to families and the public to witness students receiving their qualifications.

events.title: Griffith University — Writing Your Literature Review Workshop
events.description: This workshop builds on research literature management skills, offering strategies to plan, structure, and write an effective literature review. It is suitable for graduate researchers and curious community members seeking to improve their academic writing.

events.title: Nature Journaling Meetup — Gold Coast
events.location: Private rural property, Gold Coast hinterland
events.description: A beginner-friendly workshop designed to help participants slow down, observe nature, and practice drawing in a calm, supportive environment. Held on a private rural property, it offers simple drawing approaches to build confidence without prior experience.

events.title: Mudgeeraba Art Show — Opening Weekend
events.description: The Mudgeeraba Art Show opens its doors, featuring a diverse range of artworks across categories like Landscape, Still Life, Figurative, and Animal Portraits. All adult artwork is available for purchase, offering a chance to discover local talent.

events.title: HOTA Farmers and Artisan Market
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A vibrant community market at HOTA, featuring local produce, artisanal crafts, and a welcoming social atmosphere. It's an ideal spot to meet interesting locals, browse unique goods, and enjoy the beautiful arts precinct.

events.title: SeaFire — Fireworks on Surfers Paradise Beach
events.description: Experience an atmospheric and memorable evening as SeaFire lights up Surfers Paradise beach with a spectacular fireworks display over the water. This free community event offers a fantastic opportunity to gather with others by the beachfront.

events.title: Broadwater Pavilion Markets — Southport
events.description: These community markets at Broadwater Parklands offer a scenic waterfront setting for browsing local goods and socialising. It's a great opportunity to explore the local precinct, meet community members, and enjoy a pleasant Gold Coast morning.

events.title: Rogue Traders — The Anthems 21st Anniversary Tour
events.description: Catch live indie-pop nostalgia from iconic Australian act Rogue Traders as they celebrate their 21st anniversary tour. Confirm the specific Gold Coast date and ticket details directly with The Star Gold Coast's program for this week.

events.title: Grazy Arvo with Koalas — Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
events.description: Enjoy an intimate, hands-on wildlife encounter at Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary, offering a low-key and authentic experience with koalas. This ongoing event provides a unique opportunity to connect with nature and Australian wildlife.
